name: Rimmen Necropolis
summary: Rimmen Necropolis is a public dungeon found in northeastern Northern Elsweyr, located southwest of Rimmen. Darloc Brae and his army are buried here, along with several important Manes. Daedra have invaded the tombs, and are now stuck in an everlasting battle against the undead defenders. Beetles, centipedes, rats, scorpions, skavengers and torchbugs are found in significant numbers inside. The Tomb of the Moon-Singers can be accessed via a trapdoor in the bottom left passage.
